name: ladder
description: Closed-model stepped ramp-up -- finds the capacity knee. Criterion: TPS stops rising with VUs while P95 starts climbing steeply.
_closed_model: WARNING: closed model: each VU sends a request, waits for the response, then sends the next. When the server slows down the load slows down with it, which **systematically underestimates the consequences of overload**. Good enough for finding the knee, but to see 'what happens past the knee' you must use the arrival profile.
_ramp: 300s per step, no gap between steps; to distinguish step boundaries in Grafana, run each step individually instead: -e PROFILE=baseline -e VUS=N
